condo.label: Condo building
condo.text: This lot is a condominium. Suplex checks the City's free multiplex designs on house lots only.

non_residential.label: Not a residential house zone
non_residential.text: The zoning here is not one of the residential house zones (R, RD, RS, RT or RM), so the free multiplex designs are not checked.

older_bylaw.label: An older zoning bylaw applies here
older_bylaw.text: This lot is not part of the citywide Zoning By-law 569-2013. An older bylaw still applies here, and Suplex does not read it.

larger_building.label: Already a larger building
larger_building.text: There is already a larger building on this lot, such as an apartment building or a building with several addresses, so Suplex does not treat it as a house lot.

unmeasurable.label: Lot shape too irregular to measure
unmeasurable.text: Suplex could not measure this lot reliably: the shape is irregular, there is no clear street edge, or there is more than one building on it.

attached.label: Attached house (semi or row)
attached.text: The house on this lot shares a wall with a neighbour. The City's free designs are detached buildings that need open side yards on both sides.

checked.label: Checked
checked.text: Suplex checked the City's four free multiplex designs on this lot.

outside_toronto.label: Outside Toronto
outside_toronto.text: Suplex covers addresses inside the City of Toronto.

heritage_register.label: Heritage register
heritage_register.text: This property is on the City's Heritage Register. Changes to it may need heritage review.

heritage_district.label: Heritage conservation district
heritage_district.text: This lot is in a heritage conservation district. New buildings there may need heritage review.

ravine.label: Ravine protection area
ravine.text: Part of this lot is in the City's ravine and natural feature protection area. Work near trees and slopes there may need a permit.

trca.label: TRCA regulated area
trca.text: Part of this lot is in the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority's regulated area. Building there may need a TRCA permit.

site_exception.label: Site-specific exception
site_exception.text: This zone has a site-specific exception ({exception}), which Suplex does not read.
site_exception.text_without_number: This zone has a site-specific exception, which Suplex does not read.

vacant.label: No building here today
vacant.text: No building was found on this lot in the City's 3D Massing data. It was checked like any other lot.

rules_plain.detached_building: the house is attached (a semi or row house)
rules_plain.units_allowed: sixplexes are not allowed in this ward
rules_plain.lot_width: lot too narrow for the side yards
rules_plain.lot_depth: lot too shallow for the front and rear yards
rules_plain.building_length: lot not deep enough for the longer building
rules_plain.height: height limit lower than the design
rules_plain.lot_coverage: the building would cover too much of the lot

attached_note: The City's free designs are for detached lots. You may still be able to add homes in other ways, such as a basement or garden suite, which Suplex doesn't check.
